The peak inside a firing clause lands where the technical material starts, either on the first sub-word chunk of the learned word (' mult' in multivariate, ' rem' in remanded, 'linear', 'statistically', 'con' in concludes, 'ineffective') or on a determiner or quantifier that opens the technical phrase (' a' in 'state a claim', ' the' in 'on the rationale', 'any', 'all'), and it is unchanged by the word that follows, so it labels text already read rather than an upcoming token.
